name: @red-cup-engineering/research-release-metadata-service
description: One paper.yaml in, every research-release metadata file out: CITATION.cff 1.2.0, Zenodo .zenodo.json, codemeta 3.0 JSON-LD and schema.org ScholarlyArticle JSON-LD, byte-reproducibly, plus a drift check across the existing files. Models AI-collaborator disclosure faithfully: an AI system may be credited but never holds accountability.

scripts.check: for file in scripts/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$file" || exit; done

framings.title: Check release metadata consistency
framings.description: Check existing CITATION.cff, .zenodo.json, codemeta.json and scholarly-article.jsonld texts against what a paper.yaml projects. Reports every missing, unexpected and different value, absent or unparseable file, and any AI system credited as leading author or creator. Deterministic.

paper.title: An Example Paper
paper.abstract: A short abstract describing the example paper.
